Celebrating the Global Simultaneous Release, BCG Fest feat. ONE PIECE CARD GAME is here!
Make the most of this special weekend and dive into the game.
Don’t miss special events, exclusive products, and exciting activities!
Jaarbeurs Utrecht, Jaarbeursplein 6, 3521 AL Utrecht, Netherlands
*General entry is free but requires registration through TCG+.
Enjoy special events like the Flame-Flame Fruit Coliseum and CS26–27 Season 1 Finals, Season 2 Regionals, plus a wide range of side events.
Joining this event will require application in advance.
Please refer to official event communications for the most up-to-date dates, times, and event information.
There are many alternative forms of transportation.
Special products to commemorate “Flame-Flame Fruit Coliseum” will be available for purchase.
